items.name: Alteryx
items.description: Data analytics platform providing visual workflow tools for data blending, preparation, and advanced analytics.

items.name: Apache Avro
items.description: Data serialization framework that encodes data in a compact binary format along with its schema, commonly used for exchanging data between systems in the Hadoop ecosystem.

items.name: Apache Hadoop
items.description: Open-source framework for distributed storage and processing of large datasets across clusters of commodity hardware, built around HDFS and the MapReduce processing model.

items.name: Apache Parquet
items.description: Columnar storage file format optimized for efficient compression and query performance, widely used for analytical workloads in big data processing engines.

items.name: Apache Spark
items.description: Distributed computing engine for processing large-scale data in parallel across clusters, supporting batch processing, streaming, machine learning, and SQL workloads.

items.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
items.description: Microsoft cloud service that combines data warehousing, big data analytics, and data integration into a single platform for querying and analyzing large datasets.

items.name: Databricks
items.description: Cloud-based platform built around Apache Spark that provides tools for data engineering, data science, and machine learning workflows, including notebooks and managed clusters.

items.name: Dataform
items.description: Google Cloud service for defining, testing, and orchestrating SQL-based data transformations within data warehouses, supporting version control and dependency management.

items.name: dbt
items.description: Command-line and cloud tool that lets analysts and engineers transform data in a warehouse using SQL, managing dependencies, testing, and documentation for transformation pipelines.

items.name: Google Cloud Dataprep
items.description: Cloud-based service for visually exploring, cleaning, and preparing structured and unstructured data for analysis or downstream processing.

items.name: IBM InfoSphere DataStage
items.description: Enterprise ETL tool used to design and run data integration jobs that extract, transform, and load data across various sources and targets.

items.name: Informatica PowerCenter
items.description: Enterprise data integration tool used to build ETL pipelines that extract, transform, and load data between diverse systems and databases.

items.name: LookML
items.description: Modeling language used in Looker to define data relationships, metrics, and business logic that get translated into SQL queries for analytics.

items.name: Pandas
items.description: Python library providing data structures like DataFrames for manipulating, cleaning, and analyzing tabular and time-series data.

items.name: Presto
items.description: Distributed SQL query engine designed to run interactive analytic queries against data stored in various sources, including large-scale data lakes.

items.name: PySpark
items.description: Python API for Apache Spark that allows developers to write distributed data processing and analytics jobs using Python instead of Scala or Java.

items.name: SAP BusinessObjects
items.description: Business intelligence platform offering reporting, dashboarding, and ad hoc query tools for analyzing enterprise data.

items.name: Seaborn
items.description: Python data visualization library built on top of matplotlib that provides higher-level functions for creating statistical charts and graphs.

items.name: Spark SQL
items.description: Module within Apache Spark that enables querying structured and semi-structured data using SQL syntax alongside Spark's distributed processing capabilities.

items.name: SQL Server Integration Services
items.description: Microsoft ETL and data integration tool bundled with SQL Server, used to build workflows for extracting, transforming, and loading data between systems.
